note: Three proposal anchors were verified verbatim against the frozen v5.4.45 tree and the fix hunks. CVE-2026-109413 was anchored in Form/FormRenderer.php by the proposal but the advisory and fix concern the YAML inline lexer; it is held here and relocated to the Yaml Parser via promote_candidate.py (see relocated_rows).

rows.reason: Wrong component: the proposal anchored FormRenderer::searchAndRenderBlock, but the advisory and the fix are about unbounded recursion in the YAML inline lexer. 116287c3b5bc is the 5.4.54 release merge (14 patches); patch 01/14 is the lexer fix 2a8bf9c58d86, which wraps Parser::lexInlineStructure with enterNestingLevel/leaveNestingLevel. Relocate to src/Symfony/Component/Yaml/Parser.php lexInlineStructure 1239-1263.

Fix 3b7969f51f50 '[ExpressionLanguage] Bound the nesting level of parsed' removes the recursive descent block of parseExpression at frozen lines 135-151 and rebuilds it as an explicit bounded stack (MAX_NESTING_LEVEL check around the pushed children). The removed lines are present verbatim at the anchor, in the function named by the advisory.

Fix 18ecd03eda39 '[Process] Use %PATH% before %CD% to load the shell on Windows' removes the relative invocation "cmd /V:ON /E:ON /D /C (...)" at frozen line 1595 (inside prepareWindowsCommandLine) in favour of the absolute ComSpec path, which is exactly the cmd.exe current-directory hijack described in the advisory.

Fix 343a1772ce6a '[HttpFoundation] Remove the ambiguity that makes HeaderUtils::split() backtrack' rewrites the token alternation of the preg_match_all pattern; the removed lines at frozen 61-63 ([^"'.$quotedSeparators.']+ / )+ / (?<!\s)) are the matcher the advisory describes as exponentially ambiguous.

relocated_rows.reason: The real fix is patch 01/14 of the 5.4.54 merge (2a8bf9c58d86, cherry-picked from 2c5677e4f5cd): lexInlineStructure now enters/leaves the shared nesting level around the lexer body, which was renamed doLexInlineStructure. The frozen v5.4.45 function at 1239-1263 is the unguarded self-recursive lexer, calling lexInlineMapping/lexInlineSequence for every '{' and '['.
